newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Haw Par say has settlement with Jack Chia.
newsitem.headline: Haw Par say has settlement with Jack Chia.

text.p: Trading-based Haw Par Brothers International said on Monday the company and its subsidiary Tiger Medicals Ltd had reached an amicable settlement with Jack Chia-MPH Ltd for an outstanding lawsuit.
It said in a statement that the suit was brought against Jack Chia-MPH in relation to the latter's manufacture, marketing and distribution of Golden Lion Shield Balm products.
Haw Par's subsidiary Tiger Medicals also makes a balm product.
The statement gave no details of the settlement, but said it is not expected to have a material impact on group net earnings for the current year.

In a separate statement confirming the settlement, Jack Chia said it expected to write off about Singapore $1.45 million in debts unrecoverable from the joint venture companies involved in the manufacture, distribution and marketing of balm products.
